description: Global Seismic Hazard Map is a data resource listed in Free GIS Data (rtwilson), a curated list of free geographic datasets under the section "Natural Disasters", published or maintained by the publisher of gmo.gfz-potsdam.de. Gridded data showing hazard risk of seismic activity across the globe. Coverage: worldwide or as described in the list entry. The list files it under "Natural Disasters". The entry links to gmo.gfz-potsdam.de. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated in the list entry (source page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure mapping and planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-free-gis-data-list.
licence: not stated in the list entry (source page not read)
